proof_roadmap: Vanishing of the outer groups gives the middle (proof lines 7332-7334).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that if the sequences obtained by appending one element and by appending another are H1-regular, respectively Koszul regular, then so is the sequence obtained by appending their product. The proof is short and consists of applying the standard exact sequence that compares the Koszul homology of the three sequences obtained by appending the first element, the product, and the second element: the two outer homology groups vanish in the relevant degrees by hypothesis, so the exactness of the sequence forces the middle group to vanish in the same degrees, which is precisely the regularity statement. The author states the exact sequences and the conclusion follows in one step from them.
